title: Umudugudu uri ku nkombe z'urubanza
intro: Usanga uri mu mudugudu uri ku nkombe z'inyanja, aho urusaku rw'imiraba ruvanze n'amajwi y'abantu bibagiranye. Bahawe itegeko ryo kuruhuka, ariko umururumba wabo watumye bahabwa igihano kikivugwa mu ijwi rituje. Ese ushobora kumenya abo ari bo?
clues: Twari dutuye ku nkombe kandi twahawe itegeko ryo kubahiriza umunsi wo kuruhuka.
Kuri uwo munsi, amafi yazaga kuri twe ari menshi, ariko twari tubujijwe kuyafata.
Bamwe muri twe twaburiye kutagira icyo dukora, ariko abandi bagambanira kuroba uko byagenda kose.
Twarenze ku itegeko ryera maze twizanira igihano gikomeye.
Igihano cyacu cyari impinduka yadusize tubabaye kandi tugizwe ipfunwe.
arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
